previous_result: V1 finished all 48 frozen trials: 2/12 nominal live, 1/12 nominal frozen, 3/12 pushed live, 0/12 pushed frozen. Seven seeds were refused before motion. Preserve the complete package; do not tune that candidate or reuse its final scenes for selection.
purpose: Distinguish neural-map approximation failures from orientation/workspace limits, then test a bounded corrective revision only if diagnostics support one.
baseline: Keep models/dinner_suite, bottle_visual, bottle_relays and bottle_servo_v1 unchanged.
observer: Frozen V4 observer and rigid 103 mm geometry from models/bottle_servo_v1; no further perception training in this protocol.
stages: A: Compare the V1 neural motor guard against offline IK at the original 24 XY grid points and grasp/approach/lift heights, plus all three destination heights. At most two solver starts per point/arm; retain every refusal and solver failure. These are kinematic probes, not physical successes.

B: If approximation error is a material source of refusals, collect bounded extra kinematic labels and refine a separate motor candidate. Preserve the 1.5 mm / 0.025 axis guard and joint limits. No runtime IK, object-state input or nearest-demonstration action retrieval.

C: Test at most two controller revisions on exposed training/development cases. Evaluate image-based correction after grasp only where the frozen observer remains observable. Reject missing/ambiguous images explicitly; retain every failed trial.
D: Freeze source/models before all 48 new final trials: nominal live, nominal frozen, pushed live and pushed frozen. Preserve all 12 seeds per condition, including unsupported goals.
pose_generator: Unchanged original uniform XY/yaw generator; evaluation outcomes may not inform candidate selection.
promotion_gate: At least 8/12 nominal-live and 8/12 pushed-live physical successes, with unchanged monitors, and a live-image advantage over frozen images among at least four seeds where both nominal conditions pass. Otherwise keep experimental; report every result.
scope: Known upright bottle and finite workspace only. Solver failure is not proof of physical unreachability; a kinematic solution is not proof of collision-free manipulation.
